challenge.notes: Official-style 5K 2-step: P1 +$500 / P2 +$250; max daily loss $250; max overall $500; min 10 trading days per phase. Hyro cap: 3% = $150 risk/trade + SL within ~5 min. 40% consistency: cap ~$200/day in P1 and ~$100/day in P2 toward targets — verify exact Hyro wording. Hyro is crypto futures/perps only — use symbols exactly as shown on their platform (USDT pairs below are hints).
